text:
maria (partnerships): Hey team — heads up that CobaltCloud confirmed a co-hosted session + shared booth at CloudInfraCon on Apr 16. Need to lock speaker list, demo owner, run-of-show, and swag shipping deadlines. Partner wants a co-announcement on their marketplace listing. Rough agenda: 20m joint keynote, 15m live demo, 10m Q&A. Can we confirm?

aj (product): I can do the product portion for 20m. Need someone to own the live infra demo. @dave any chance you can lead?

dave (eng): I can run the live demo but want a pre-recorded fallback in case of network/hw issues. Will need a booth laptop with an A100 (or equivalent) and wired ethernet. Also need a demo token for remote calls (short-lived). Runbook: https://redwood.dev/runbooks/cloudinfracon-2026

keisha (CobaltCloud): Hi all — Cobalt can send 2 speakers (me + Sam, CTO). Weʼd like a short joint blurb for the Cobalt Cloud Marketplace spot. On swag: we can share shipping costs if Redwood covers printing.

olivia (events ops): Swag deadlines: items must arrive at staging by Apr 7. Typical counts: tees 200, stickers 500, dongles/adapters 40. If shipping internationally, allow extra 7–10 days for customs. Need commercial invoice + CN22. Please send final counts + SKUs by Apr 1.

maria (partnerships): Shipping address for Redwood booth: Redwood Inference / CloudInfraCon Logistics / 123 Convention Way, Suite B / Seattle, WA 98101. Account #: 8891. Use "Booth 42 / CobaltCloud & Redwood" on label.

raj (marketing): Draft co-announcement copy is in Figma (link in #marketing). We need logo assets (SVG/PNG) from Cobalt by Mar 25 and legal sign-off on the marketplace phrasing: "Available on Cobalt Cloud Marketplace."

elaine (legal): High-level ok but I need partner MSA ID and trademark usage approvals. @keisha can you route legal contact and trademark guidelines to me?

aj (product): For the demo script we should highlight batching + prefix caching latency improvements and show actual numbers. Need a small synthetic dataset and a load generator. @tomas can you provide a perf harness?

tomas (eng-ml): Yep — I'll spin up a perf harness and a synthetic trace. Example command for the demo cluster: `./harness -host demo.redwood.net -model redwood-xl-8k -rps 50 -seq 512` — will produce reproducible latency p95 numbers.

dave (eng): I'll prepare a 3-min fallback video of the demo flow, and confirm HDMI/adapter compatibility on the booth laptop. Also: who approves travel for a backup engineer?

maria (partnerships): We have 2 headcount in the budget for on-site engineers. Please submit travel requests by Mar 30. Action items: logos (raj), legal contact (keisha -> elaine), perf harness (tomas), demo owner + fallback video (dave), final swag counts & shipping labels (olivia). Next check-in Wed 2026-03-27 10:00 PT.

keisha (CobaltCloud): We'll send speaker bios and legal contact by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Reminder: create canary deploy for demo model by 2026-03-28.

olivia (events ops): Quick note — if partner ships from EU, suggest earlier cutoff due to customs. Also confirm whether dongles are FCC/CE labeled (customs sometimes flags electronics).

maria (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll collate assignees into the runbook and ping calendar invite for the 3/27 check-in.
